hypothesis: An offline inventory-to-candidate pipeline with closed installed contracts can preserve evidence and support technical challenge without importing existing operational approval assumptions.
expected_observation: Fixed inputs and clock produce identical candidates; malformed, stale, colliding and self-authorizing inputs cannot enable activation or overwrite state silently.

reuse_analysis.observation: Content-addressed records, safe names and atomic replacement are compatible patterns; research topic indexes are not institutional continuation contracts.
reuse_analysis.decision: reuse patterns, not duplicate research memory

reuse_analysis.observation: Script-local compressed checkpoint manager has a different schema and storage lifecycle; not an installed codex runtime dependency.
reuse_analysis.decision: retain existing mechanism; add a narrowly scoped installed candidate adapter

reuse_analysis.observation: Existing approval input is a boolean, not authenticated artifact-bound separation evidence.
reuse_analysis.decision: do not equate boolean approval with institutional activation; deny activation in this slice

reuse_analysis.observation: Existing codex entry point loads optional ML CLI infrastructure.
reuse_analysis.decision: add codex-institutional entry point and module invocation, leaving legacy CLI behavior unchanged

contradiction_search.method: Read-only exploration of existing authority, evidence, checkpoint and governance modules; direct packaging/CLI tracing; filename census.
contradiction_search.alternative_cause: The gap is integration and portable contract enforcement, not evidence that existing agents are ineffective.
contradiction_search.dissent: A separate continuation adapter adds maintenance cost; extending the script manager could be preferable after packaging and contract compatibility are established.
contradiction_search.uncertainty: No exhaustive semantic census or independent effectiveness evaluation was performed.
contradiction_search.scope_limits: Agent-profile contents are inaccessible under the task environment boundary. Governance YAML paths requested by the task are absent in this checkout.

slice: Read-only inventory, deterministic assessment/challenge, validated Draft experience, atomic candidate checkpoint, explicit preview/write, classified export, technical verification and non-destructive disengagement plan.

acceptance_matrix.G0: Preserve initial startup packet; record policy and source identity.
acceptance_matrix.G1: Complete source tree path census, reconciled primary classifications; semantic coverage separate.
acceptance_matrix.G2: This inactive ADR and frozen test expectations precede implementation.
acceptance_matrix.G3: Installed contracts and runnable inventory-to-candidate path.
acceptance_matrix.G4: Negative schema, poison, drift, authority, mutation, disclosure and recovery tests.
acceptance_matrix.G5: NOT_RUN until independently established reproduction; review agents do not establish final approval.
acceptance_matrix.G6: Record wheel digest, contents and installed resources.
acceptance_matrix.G7: External harness with no source-path assistance; dependency provisioning limitations disclosed.
acceptance_matrix.G8: Validated experience and continuation candidate with next deterministic action.

template_adaptation.testing: Existing pytest, coverage, Ruff, Black, isort, mypy and compile tools; fixed-clock expectations; minimum 80% new-module line coverage.
template_adaptation.troubleshooting: At most two retries per unchanged failure; preserve failed observations; report environment/dependency limits rather than weakening assertions.
template_adaptation.rollback: Revert only this task's changes through reviewed commits; installed disengagement is read-only and preserves historical artifacts; no destructive cleanup.
template_adaptation.progress: Use actual gate results, not scores or role names. Candidate self-tests do not establish independent approval.

next_cycles: Independent reproduction and withheld tests against a bound candidate wheel.
Trusted identity/approval integration with operation-specific authority and expiry/revocation evidence before any activation.
Knowledge supersession and conflicting-decision workflows with preserved dissent and actual supported migrations.
